attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: business_rule_extraction_from_process_document
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_pipeline
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "pipeline_service"
      description: "Authenticate the upload pipeline service"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_fetch_document
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/knowledge-base/documents/latest"
      description: "Receive the process document from the upload pipeline"
    output: raw_document

  - id: step_validate_document
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_document
      schema: process_document_schema
      description: "Validate the raw document structure before processing"
    output: validated_document

  - id: step_extract_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_document
      field: "document_text"
      description: "Extract the document text content from the uploaded document"
    output: document_text

  - id: step_call_llm_langgraph
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: langgraph_rule_extraction
      input_data:
        text: document_text
      timeout_seconds: 300
      description: "Call LLM via LangGraph to identify and extract individual business rules"
    output: raw_extracted_rules

  - id: step_validate_rules_structure
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_extracted_rules
      schema: business_rules_array_schema
      description: "Validate the extracted rules structure from LLM output"
    output: validated_rules

  - id: step_transform_rules_with_status
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_rules
      mapping:
        status: "pending_review"
        searchable: false
      description: "Add pending_review status and non-searchable flag to each rule"
    output: rules_with_status

  - id: step_handle_write_errors
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: step_log_failure
      steps:
        - step_store_rules
        - step_generate_embeddings
        - step_store_embeddings

  - id: step_store_rules
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      step: step_write_rule
    output: stored_rules

  - id: step_write_rule
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      table: business_rules
      columns:
        - rule_id
        - rule_text
        - source_document_id
        - status
        - searchable
        - created_at
    output: write_rules_result

  - id: step_generate_embeddings
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: embedding_generation
      input_data:
        rules: rules_with_status
        dimensions: 4096
      timeout_seconds: 300
      description: "Generate 4096-dimension embeddings for each extracted rule"
    output: raw_embeddings

  - id: step_validate_embeddings
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_embeddings
      schema: embeddings_array_schema
      description: "Validate embedding output structure and dimensions"
    output: validated_embeddings

  - id: step_transform_embeddings
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_embeddings
      mapping:
        link_to: "business_rules.rule_id"
        dimensions: 4096
        storage: "pgvector"
      description: "Transform embeddings to include rule linkage metadata"
    output: linked_embeddings

  - id: step_store_embeddings
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: linked_embeddings
      table: rule_embeddings_pgvector
      columns:
        - rule_id
        - embedding_vector
        - dimensions
        - created_at
    output: write_embeddings_result

  - id: step_notify_validators
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      recipient_role: "rule_validator"
      message: "New business rules extracted and pending review"
      channel: "email"
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_log_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      action: "business_rules_extracted"
      details:
        document_source: "knowledge_base_upload"
        rule_count: "derived_from_rules"
        status: "pending_review"
        embeddings_stored: true
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "Business rules extracted, stored, embedded, and flagged for review"

  - id: step_log_failure
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      action: "business_rule_extraction_failed"
      details:
        error: "Pipeline failure during rule storage or embedding"
    output: failure_audit_result

  - id: step_terminate_failure
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      message: "Business rule extraction pipeline failed"
